description: Reviewed capture-qualified quotations accepted by N4 (naming-candidate.py compare --reviewed-quotations). Each record is accepted only where it occurs, with this before/after spelling, pre-resolving to map_old, and with the after spelling exactly map_old's fully qualified new name; an unlisted occurrence fails and an unused record is stale. Retired at G0b (jsn-u18, master decision 2026-11-17); it remains in Git history at 904d7fff.
